language_rules.permitted: Any Google-supported language may target any supported country, including minority-language users, subject to country, account, offer and buyer requirements.
language_rules.not_required: Neither 21 locales per country nor every possible Cartesian combination is a Merchant requirement. Country-language possibilities are not required uploads.
language_rules.matching: Feed title, description and variant information, landing-page purchase information and checkout navigation must match the chosen source language.
language_rules.quality: Published Shopify locale flags and roots do not establish complete or accurate translations, accessible pages, buyability, native checkout or demand.
language_rules.mapping: pt-BR maps by language name to Brazilian Portuguese; el to Modern Greek; no to Norwegian. This review does not certify the source creation API/UI language enum.

rollout_recommendation.next_action: Root should finish receiver and buyer qualification of the existing priority English cohorts, then read Merchant513 selectable countries and organic capacity before the next grouped expansion.
sequence: Preserve existing offer IDs and single-source ownership; finish current US/AU/CA/GB English receipt and buyer gates.
Reuse a qualified existing language/currency/price context for additional documented countries only where a stable shared link and each destination checkout preserve offer truth.
Prepare the next verified EUR country group and relevant local-language cohorts; expand one coherent group at a time after source processing and country-specific free-listing status readback.
Use actual clicks, purchases, returns and contribution after costs to select subsequent language groups; these outcomes are not established by this review.
Hold beta El Salvador, Russia serving qualification and the 38 unlisted countries for explicit account/operational evidence. Do not map territories to another country merely to bypass absence.
split_when: Product price/currency/tax total differs across destination contexts
A shared stable URL cannot preserve selected variant, language and submitted currency through checkout
Offer eligibility or shipping exclusions require different country coverage
avoid: One duplicate feed per country when a single offer already fits multiple countries
Full language-country Cartesian expansion without language quality, demand and capacity
Changing existing successful identities merely to make a prettier global naming scheme
Inventing shipping, return, stock or manufacturer facts
Using local inventory/free local listings for this online-only dropshipping store

required_match: Submitted original product price and currency on landing and checkout
Shipping service/cost currency equals offer currency
Applicable product tax and cross-border charge rules
No IP-based automatic language/currency switching of submitted landing content

native_readback: Merchant513 Products > Needs attention for product-limit errors
Data sources for existing source count, processing counts, latest successful update and exact language/feed-label/offer identities
Business info > Countries > Add countries for target selectability
Organic limit and remaining capacity from an explicit account readback or Google confirmation if not exposed; do not infer from lack of errors or Ads quota
capacity.api_guide_endpoint_conflict: Current reference/release notes specify quota/v1; the guide still displays an older accounts/v1 example. Use the reference; do not try guessed organic limit IDs.
capacity.operational_formula: Compute distinct existing-plus-proposed offer identities within each language/feed-label/source context using the fresh eligible variants; target-country coverage alone need not duplicate every row.
capacity.expansion_precheck: Compare explicit organic remaining capacity and source/upload capacity against the actual proposed delta before broad upload; preserve current successful offers.
